scripts.dev: concurrently -n livekit,server,client -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:livekit" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.test: tsx --test shared/*.test.ts server/src/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.ts client/src/world2d/*.test.ts client/src/world2d/draw/*.test.ts
